job = list(
  title   = "Research Data Scientist, Magic Eye",
  company = "Google",
  salary  = list(min = 147000, max = 210000)
)
str(job)

List of 3
 $ title  : chr "Research Data Scientist, Magic Eye"
 $ company: chr "Google"
 $ salary :List of 2
  ..$ min: num 147000
  ..$ max: num 210000

# 1. The company name
# 2. The max salary
# 3. The maximum salary again, using only []
# 4. The names of the elements in the job

company = job$company
max_salary = job$salary$max
max_salary_alt = job[[3]][[2]]
names(job)

```
{r subset_vec}
crashes_by_day = c(2020, 2241, 2327, 2285, 2380, 1866, 1664)
names(crashes_by_day) = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu",
                          "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
crashes_by_day[2]    # one position

crashes_by_day[c("Wed","Fri")]
crashes_by_day[c(3,5)]
crashes_by_day[1:5] # Only works for elements in a row
crashes_by_day[]# returns all the elements --> no diff than crashes_by_day
```
